# Veda Brahma Shri Pradeep Nadig - Vedic Scholar & Spiritual Guide

> Official website and LLM directory for Veda Brahma Shri Pradeep Nadig, providing authentic Vedic astrology consultations, traditional Homas, Griha Pravesha pujas, Vedic education workshops, and spiritual services in Bangalore and online worldwide.

Veda Brahma Shri Pradeep Nadig is a highly revered Vedic Pandit, Astrologer, and Spiritual Guide based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. With decades of deep expertise in Krishna Yajurveda, Jyotishya (Vedic Astrology), Prashna Shastra, and Vastu Shastra, Shri Pradeep Nadig provides authentic ritual services, personalized horoscope readings, and structured Vedic learning courses.

## Core Pages & Services

- [Home](https://pradeepnadig.in/): Overview of Veda Brahma Shri Pradeep Nadig, core philosophy, and quick service access.
- [Services & Consultations](https://pradeepnadig.in/services): Complete listing of authentic Vedic pujas, homas, and astrology consultation offerings.
- [Workshops](https://pradeepnadig.in/workshops): Upcoming and ongoing interactive Vedic education workshops, sloka learning sessions, and astrology modules.
- [Classes](https://pradeepnadig.in/classes): Structured online and offline classes for Veda Adhyayana, Stotra chanting, and Vedic astrology.
- [Live Events](https://pradeepnadig.in/live-events): Community pujas, mass homas, festival celebrations, and live broadcasts (e.g., Rudrabhishekam, Chandi Homa).
- [Blogs & Knowledge Center](https://pradeepnadig.in/blogs): In-depth articles on Vedic rituals, astrological dosha remedies, muhurta selection, and spiritual wisdom.
- [FAQ](https://pradeepnadig.in/faq): Frequently asked questions regarding booking procedures, required ritual samagri, horoscope preparation, and online consultations.
- [Gallery](https://pradeepnadig.in/gallery): Visual showcase of past Vedic ceremonies, homas, and community events.
- [Contact & Booking](https://pradeepnadig.in/contact): Official contact information, direct WhatsApp enquiry links, and location details.

## Specialized Homas & Ritual Services

- [Ganapathi Homa](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/ganapathi-homa): Sacred fire ritual for removing obstacles, invoking auspicious beginnings, and prosperity.
- [Navagraha Homa](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/navagraha-homa): Comprehensive 9-planet fire ritual to mitigate astrological planetary doshas and bring balance.
- [Mrityunjaya Homa](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/mrityunjaya-homa): Powerful ritual dedicated to Lord Shiva for health, longevity, and recovery from severe illness.
- [Vastu Homa & Griha Pravesha](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/vastu-homa): Traditional housewarming ceremonies, Vastu Purusha worship, and energy sanctification for new homes and apartments in Bangalore.
- [Ayushya Homa](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/ayushya-homa): Longevity and health blessing ceremony traditionally performed on birthdays or for young infants.
- [Naga Shanthi & Sarpa Dosha Puja](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/naga-shanthi): Specialized rituals for Rahu-Ketu dosha, Sarpa dosha mitigation, and family lineage blessings.

## Astrology & Consultation Services

- [Horoscope & Kundali Reading](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/kundali-reading): In-depth birth chart analysis, Janma Kundali evaluation, Dasha-Bhukti breakdown, and life guidance.
- [Prashna Marga (Horary Astrology)](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/prashna-marga): Immediate astrological query resolution when precise birth time details are unknown or for urgent life decisions.
- [Matchmaking & Vivaha Kundali](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/matchmaking): Vedic horoscope compatibility evaluation (Ashtakoota, Dashakoota, Manglik dosha analysis) for marriage.
- [Vastu Consultancy](https://pradeepnadig.in/services/vastu-consultancy): Residential and commercial site layout evaluation according to authentic Vastu Shastra principles.

## Service Locations & Availability

- **In-Person Services**: Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India - including Yelahanka, Vidyaranyapura, Hebbal, Sahakara Nagar, Malleswaram, Rajajinagar, Jayanagar, Indiranagar, Whitefield, and surrounding areas.
- **Online Consultations**: Available globally for NRI clients across the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, and Singapore via Zoom / Video Call.
